rating.comments: The student makes no real mistake (only minor spelling slips, which are not conceptual), so the mistake dimensions are null. The AI asks open questions at each turn ("What do you think are some positive aspects...", "how might you use social media responsibly...") and leaves the reasoning to the student, though the final turn supplies the conclusion "neither inherently good nor bad". Each turn builds on the previous one and ends with a concrete question, leading back to the original question. Praise is warm but fairly generic ("great point", "great idea").
